image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs exhibit the characteristic reddish-orange coloration of cooked crustaceans. Multiple carapaces are visible, some whole and some fragmented or obscured by others in the pile. Prominent claws (chelipeds) with white tips and orange-red segments are scattered throughout. Legs are intertwined. The texture appears hard and calcified, consistent with crab shells. There is significant occlusion due to the stacking of multiple subjects.
